-- Count active members in Tampere (made at least one purchase in trailing 52 weeks)
-- As-of date: 2026-10-04 (last complete fiscal week Sunday)
-- Home store measured as of the as-of date
WITH as_of AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-10-04' as as_of_date
),
active_member_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fsl.member_key
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  CROSS JOIN as_of
  WHERE fsl.sale_date > as_of.as_of_date - 364
    AND fsl.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_date
    AND fsl.member_key IS NOT NULL
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
member_versions_on_as_of AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT am.member_key) as customer_count
FROM active_member_ids am
JOIN member_versions_on_as_of mv ON am.member_key = (
  SELECT member_key FROM dim_member 
  WHERE member_id = (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE member_key = am.member_key LIMIT 1)
    AND DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to
)
JOIN dim_store ds ON mv.home_store_id = ds.store_id AND ds.is_current = TRUE
WHERE ds.city = 'Tampere'

-- Count active members in Tampere
-- Active = made at least one purchase in trailing 52 weeks as of 2026-10-04
WITH active_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364
    AND fsl.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM active_members am
JOIN dim_member dm ON am.member_id = dm.member_id 
  AND DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN dm.valid_from AND dm.valid_to
JOIN dim_store ds ON dm.home_store_id = ds.store_id 
  AND ds.is_current = TRUE
WHERE ds.city = 'Tampere'

-- Count active members in Tampere (physical stores only, store_id < 900)
-- Active = made at least one purchase in trailing 52 weeks as of 2026-10-04
WITH active_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364
    AND fsl.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as customer_count
FROM active_members am
JOIN dim_member dm ON am.member_id = dm.member_id 
  AND DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN dm.valid_from AND dm.valid_to
JOIN dim_store ds ON dm.home_store_id = ds.store_id 
  AND ds.is_current = TRUE
WHERE ds.city = 'Tampere'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
